body_markdown:
The WaterPro Conference is known as the “Industry Event of the Year.” NRWA tries to uphold this standard by introducing new and informative sessions to the agenda, along with other exciting events. This year, they will host the annual WaterPro Feud, the Ultimate Meter Challenge, Rural Water on Display Photo Contest, and State Association Awards, plus highlight many exciting guest speakers during the Opening Session.


[Click here to learn more](https://www.waterproconference.org/)
